performance:
This week — the complete Sun–Sat week of August 16–22 — affiliate GMV came in at $82,195 on 697 orders, up 35.9% from the prior week's $60,492 (week of August 9) and the fourth-highest week of the 13-week window. tiktokshopdeals4you led the week with $22,410 in store GMV on 1.62M views, and lifewithgingy added $12,104 from just 4 new posts — most of the week's revenue rode on evergreen content.

Over the trailing 30 days (July 24 – August 22), affiliate GMV was $347,891, up 27.4% versus the prior 30 days ($273,065), on 2,894 orders (+30.9%). Total shop GMV for the same 30-day window was $393,222 (+29.2%). Views for the 30 days were 14.82M, up only 3.4% — revenue is growing roughly eight times faster than views, which means the creator mix is shifting toward higher-converting audiences. Note the two affiliate GMV metrics: the $347,891 headline is the sum of creator store performance (video + livestream + showcase); Euka's dashboard affiliate metric reads $314,842 under its own attribution — the gap is expected, not an error.

August month-to-date (August 1–24) affiliate GMV is $248,317 versus July's full-month $275,288 — a run-rate of roughly $321K for August, about 16% ahead of July if the pace holds. No goals snapshot was attached to this run, so pacing is stated against the prior month rather than a target.

What's driving the 30-day number: L5 creators earned $121,686 — 35% of the 30-day total — from only 15 posting creators, with L3 ($78,828) and L4 ($82,346) adding another $161,174. Back Seat Extenders dominate: 14 of the top 15 videos of the 30-day window are Back Seat Ext. GMV Max spent $135,011 in the 30-day window at a blended 4.15x ROI ($560,740 attributed revenue).
creators:
Breakouts in the 30-day window (July 24 – August 22): applefinds5 generated $13,497 in store GMV on 36 posts — with only 55 lifetime videos for the store — and owns the window's #1 video, a July 25 Back Seat Ext. post at $6,328. subaki_the_pitty posted 190 videos in the 30 days (the most of any creator) for $12,405, and stayed the most active this week at 74 posts. _trendtreasures has just 7 lifetime videos for the store and turned them into $3,869 in the 30-day window, including a $3,465 July 31 post.

The top video actually posted this week (August 16–22) was nubbinlove's August 19 Back Seat Ext. video at $610 — new-post GMV was thin this week; the week's $82,195 was carried by evergreen catalog from tiktokshopdeals4you ($22,410 this week) and lifewithgingy ($12,104 this week).

On levels over the 30 days: L1 is the most active tier (333 posting creators, 834 videos) but the least productive at roughly $51 per posting creator; L5 is the most productive at about $8,112 per posting creator. L6/L7 activation is stalled — zero L6 or L7 creators posted in the 30-day window, and their combined $3,149 of 30-day GMV is entirely evergreen.
recruiting:
Reactivation targets, based on the 30-day window: twinsdealss ($165,567 global 30-day GMV; $7,192 store GMV in the window on zero posts), iceysteals ($135,674 global; $5,099 store GMV, zero posts, only 3 lifetime posts), richbychriss ($160,638 global; $16,779 store GMV in the window from a single post), and david.diy88 ($282,099 global — the largest creator currently posting only occasionally). Each is already proven on this catalog; a direct offer beats cold volume here.

The outreach mix is inverted versus where revenue comes from: of 154,151 initial messages in the 30 days (+12.6% vs the prior 30), 42% went to L1 creators who produced 4.9% of the 30-day GMV, while L5 — 35% of GMV — received 7.8% of messages. Samples fell to 132 (−10.8%), with none shipped to L1's replacement pipeline problem but also only 10 to L5. The competitor-list agents are the standout: the 8/5 "25K (Competitors)" agent alone drew 18 accepted invites and 24 videos.

Next week: send direct reactivation offers to the four named creators; keep the two Look Alike agents fed (they pulled 26 accepted invites combined); and ship the pending sample requests on the 8/17 "25K-100K GMV" agent, which has 44 accepted invites waiting.
growth:
The 13-week trend (weeks of May 24 through August 16) runs from $49,879 to $82,195 with a peak of $88,121 in the week of August 2 and a single outlier dip to $31,694 in the week of July 5. The last 5 weeks averaged $80.3K versus $59.7K for the prior 8 — momentum is clearly positive. The growth engine is L5 evergreen content amplified by GMV Max — but 46.2% of the $135,011 30-day GMV Max spend sits on content older than 5 months earning only 1.84x ROI, while 2–3 month-old content earns 4.34x. Rebalancing spend toward 1–3 month content is the highest-leverage move available.

Opportunities: (1) the GMV Max age rebalance above; (2) reactivating the named $100K+ global-GMV creators — richbychriss produced $16,779 in the 30-day window from one post; (3) shifting outreach and samples from L1 volume to L4/L5 and competitor/lookalike lists that are already converting. Risks: (1) weekly posting-creator retention has slid to 23.0% in the week of August 16 from 41.5% in the week of July 19 — churn is currently outrunning the record 425 new creators of the 30-day window; (2) sample volume is down 10.8% window-over-window, which starves the 5–8 week revenue pipeline.

Four-week outlook: holding the recent ~$75–88K weekly range puts the next 30-day window near $320K. Upside to ~$350K if the GMV Max rebalance lands and one L5-scale reactivation converts; downside to ~$260K if weekly retention keeps sliding and the evergreen catalog decays without fresh L4/L5 content behind it.
